<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 179.0946, which corresponds to a protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.0073 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 178.087 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass within typical high‑resolution tolerance is C₁₀H₁₄N₂O (exact mass 178.1106 Da, error ≈ 130 ppm). This fits the required “CxHyOzX” format, where X represents the nitrogen atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H14N2O</final_answer>
